audit.whatIsWrong: Even-until-late framing already matches: Dark Binding is a skillshot root neither side can force, and Zilean pulls ahead only once Chronoshift and double speed-ups outclass her single-target Soul Shackles.
audit.why: Morgana has no engage besides the 1250-range Q skillshot; Zilean has no engage at all, so nothing forces a fight before level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, only 'the three-second root'.
audit.why: Dark Binding is a flat 10s cooldown; Zilean's E is a flat 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Black Shield (E) is terrain-adjacent utility that can be used to block a slow onto an ally cutting off Zilean's own retreat option, or that Soul Siphon/Tormented Shadow sustain rewards anti-heal.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions as applicable and absent.
audit.corrected: Added the antiheal point to report[8] (itemization) and the Flash/terrain point to report[5].
